_doc: Every published strategy Elo fit, oldest first (tools/strategy_elo_history.py). A point: `at`, when it was published (the commit's time, UTC); `tables` and `runs`, what it was fitted on; `ratings`, each entrant as [elo, margin95, bound] (bound '' when the fit places it from both sides); `ladder`, the rungs as a person is shown them. Drawn over time by Charts/ELO Rankings (beta/elo_page.py).
